comparison.objective: Fit a carriage onto an open-ended undercut rail and push it through a spring detent to the stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Millimetre-clearance slide-fit alignment, insertion, resisted pushing, and release.
comparison.success_condition: Carriage captured under rail lips, within 3 mm lateral and 3 degrees level, past the plunger, within 3 mm of the stop, released and still for 1 s.
comparison.reason: This tests constrained translational assembly through a detent, not impact-induced separation and physical collection of released fragments.
